## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Shāhé bǐqiū gōngdé jīng* (T501) is a one-fascicle short sūtra by [法炬](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E7%82%AC) Fǎjù. The protagonist *Shāhé bǐqiū* 沙曷比丘 (the monk Shāhé) is a relatively obscure disciple whose merit-deeds are recounted as exemplary. The Sanskrit name behind 沙曷 is uncertain.

**Abstract**

The text is a brief avadāna-style narrative on a monastic disciple's exemplary merit (*guṇa* 功德). Translation falls within Fǎjù's productive period (290–306 CE).
